name: Samantha Wick
office: City of Burbank, Member of the City Council

items.text: Samantha Wick is a nonprofit grant writer. She serves on the Burbank Planning Commission. She previously served on the Burbank Heritage Commission, including two years as chair, and says she founded Burbank's original Buy Nothing Group. She also serves as the Planning Commission's liaison to the Art in Public Places Commission.

sentences.text: Samantha Wick is a nonprofit grant writer.
She serves on the Burbank Planning Commission.
She previously served on the Burbank Heritage Commission, including two years as chair, and says she founded Burbank's original Buy Nothing Group.
She also serves as the Planning Commission's liaison to the Art in Public Places Commission.

items.text: At a League of Women Voters forum, she said the city needs to close its $3.2 million general fund deficit. She supports mixed-flow traffic for the Olive Avenue bus rapid transit line, citing Public Works concerns about waste collection. Her campaign says she wants to protect neighborhoods and small businesses, and support tenants and seniors.
